source.branch: The hero triggers a BEAR_TRAP while mounted. After the source d(2,4), feeltrap and escape/shape checks, C sets TT_BEARTRAP. If u.usteed is present it reports the trap closing on the steed, calls thitm(0,u.usteed,NULL,dmg,FALSE), and calls reset_utrap(TRUE) only if that attack killed the steed. The hero receives neither the unmounted foot message nor the unmounted leg wound/HP loss.
callers: hack.c:spoteffects invokes trap.c:dotrap for a trap under the hero; trap.c:dotrap dispatches the hero trap to trapeffect_bear_trap.
trap.c:trapeffect_bear_trap calls trap.c:thitm for the mounted steed using the damage already rolled at function entry.
dependencies: trap.c:set_utrap and trap.c:reset_utrap update the hero's trapped state and remain existing helpers.
trap.c:thitm applies the trap's damage to the steed and supplies the death result used by reset_utrap.
